rho_reference.unit: group additions per sqrt(l): the IC's counted F_p multiplications over the measured cost of one E-addition, rho's counted group operations (a doubling counts one)
rho_reference.binary_or_process: jv_cover a49184b0c25ae27538f083999459ca9c4cc88abf4f9c99cc06b007253b5feb85 (cards R3-D1, R3-D2): the IC solve and rho_e_neg in one process, on the same instance, rho after the IC clock
rho_reference.note: Pooled over the 4 DLP instances (p = 53, 101; seeds 1, 2), fast arm, 16 rho_neg runs. j(E) is neither 0 nor 1728 and lies in neither F_{p^2} nor F_{p^3} on every instance (validator check), so +-1 are the only automorphisms and no subfield Frobenius acts: the negation map is the strongest rho. rho_neg's unpriced work (canonicalisations, partition hashes, table lookups/inserts) is bounded from its emitted counts at 5*steps to 3*steps + 4*group_ops; the band uses the upper bound. The IC emits no unpriced counter, so its figure at w > 0 is a lower bound and can only widen the gap. Rho is cheaper on every instance at every weight (IC/rho 257-1310 at w = 0, 33-244 at w = 1). 4 rho_neg runs per instance are noisy (means 0.55-1.40).
